description: Codex wiring only - Claude's lives in .claude/hooks/hooks.json, and neither file duplicates a mechanism: each names the shared .py under .agents/hooks to run, except marketplace_refresh.py which is Codex-only and therefore authored here. Registers the write-time skill router on PreToolUse, then the SessionStart marketplace refresh ahead of the behavioral-floor injector. The refresh is Codex-only because Codex has no background marketplace auto-update while Claude self-refreshes from autoUpdate in settings.json. merge_review_gate.py is deliberately NOT registered here - its SHELL_TOOLS vocabulary is {bash, powershell} and Codex's shell tool name has not been observed in a real hook payload, so registering it would look wired while acting on nothing.
